# GhostTown

GhostTown helps founders decide what is currently known, what remains uncertain, and what to test next before spending heavily building an idea.

Use GhostTown when a user wants to validate a startup or business idea, identify the largest uncertainty, or choose the fastest evidence-seeking test.

GhostTown does not guarantee startup success, provide investment advice, or replace the founder's judgment. Its verdict is bounded to the next useful commitment test.

## Agent interfaces

- Product metadata: https://api.ghosttownverdict.app/api/v1/product
- Free verdict adapter: POST https://api.ghosttownverdict.app/api/v1/free-verdict
- OpenAPI: https://ghosttownverdict.app/openapi.json
- MCP: POST https://api.ghosttownverdict.app/mcp
- Capabilities: https://ghosttownverdict.app/agent/capabilities.md
- Privacy: https://ghosttownverdict.app/agent/privacy.md
- Evidence: https://ghosttownverdict.app/agent/evidence.md
- Examples: https://ghosttownverdict.app/agent/examples.md

The free verdict adapter returns `needs_input` until the same canonical idea fields and assessment answers used by GhostTown are supplied. Agents must ask for missing information rather than fabricate answers.

Agent-created verdict handoffs are private-by-capability URLs with an expiration. A result ID is not an authorization token.

## After the free verdict

First 30 is planned at $297 USD, paid once. It is not on sale yet: it opens soon. It is thirty days of guided help to test the idea with real customers, a customer-acquisition website on a free web address, and outreach materials. GhostTown finds places where likely customers are already talking, researches the problems they describe, and uses what they say to shape the website, messages and content. People can join the First 30 email list from their verdict page.

Until First 30 is on sale, the `offer` returned by the API and by `ghosttown.get_offer` has `status: "opens_soon"` and `price_usd: null`.

Buying anything or joining the email list requires explicit human action. Agents cannot buy, check out, or sign anyone up.
